# Newsroom

> A small publishing application that exists only as a test fixture for HandOff247 (`tests/fixtures/newsroom`). Authors write articles and upload a cover image, editors review and publish them, and readers see the publish…

Handoff pack generated by HandOff247 0.6.0 on 2026-11-14 by static analysis. 114 entities and 316 relations; every relation has the file and line it was observed at.
